sections.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
sections.abstract: Introduces executable Alien Worlds in which systems discover unfamiliar rules through tools and feedback, then solve held-out tasks.
sections.claimed_contribution: ExplorationBench with AlienCode and AlienLogic sandboxes for verifiable exploration.
sections.caveat: Only 10 systems are evaluated and exploration can stall or regress.

sections.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
sections.abstract: Combines algebraic sparsification and hyperbolic structural guidance to address exploration and compounding biases in long-horizon reasoning.
sections.claimed_contribution: Symbolic Closure Analysis and SAGE structural guidance.
sections.caveat: The largest reported gain is on one task and broader transfer is uncertain.

sections.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
sections.abstract: A generator and learner co-train from random initialization, with computable programs providing an adaptive synthetic-data curriculum.
sections.claimed_contribution: A proof-of-concept for compute-limited pretraining without natural training data.
sections.caveat: Initial proof of concept, not frontier-scale pretraining.

sections.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
sections.abstract: Connects agentic data production, reinforcement learning, and model-harness co-evolution for long-horizon mobile planning.
sections.claimed_contribution: An AI-for-AI development loop and CARE reward engineering.
sections.caveat: Performance is benchmark-dependent and details are author-reported in the abstract.

sections.title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
sections.abstract: Maintains bounded multimodal memory while preserving provenance, incompatible records, and source evidence for long-horizon tasks.
sections.claimed_contribution: Relation-aware updates and budgeted routing over persistent text-image evidence.
sections.caveat: The abstract provides no quantitative results or baselines.

sections.title: Hallucination Neurons and Where to Find Them: An Investigation into the existence of Hallucination Neurons
sections.abstract: Diagnoses sparse-neuron localization claims and finds replicated predictive structure but non-unique neuron selection.
sections.claimed_contribution: A five-step diagnostic protocol for distinguishing detection from localization.
sections.caveat: The study covers specific Gemma-family settings and three datasets.
